submitted.rationale: Index 17 (Al0.17Sb0.83) had the highest measured EQE, 0.0176%. That is about 30x more than index 8 (0.00059%) and about 90x more than index 20 (0.00020%). XRD shows that indices 17 and 20 contain the same Sb-oxide phase, so the EQE peak is sharp and falls within the Sb-rich single-phase region, not at the Sb-rich end of the composition line. Index 13 shows an extra weak peak at Q=1.93, meaning a second phase is present.
